capabilities: Cap installed community plugins using the formula 5 + floor(total files / 10)
Disable the Browse and Install buttons in Community Plugins settings once the limit is reached
Show a tooltip prompting users to create more files to unlock further installs
Track total vault file count in the background during normal use
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; screenshots are referenced but their content is not described in the README.
motivation: The author built it to combat "productivity procrastination" and keep users focused on writing and creating content rather than tinkering with plugins.
problem: Obsidian makes it easy to fall into productivity procrastination, endlessly browsing and configuring plugins instead of writing notes.
summary: Plugin that caps the number of installed community plugins based on vault file count, unlocking more installs as the vault grows.
